_about: Public-domain Christian Friedrich Schmid (1794-1852, Tübingen) in English for the Word Hoard: Biblical Theology of the New Testament, tr. G. H. Venables from the fourth German edition edited by C. Weizsäcker (Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark, 1870), from an Internet Archive scan.
